prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: Two mates. Two mates were going along the forest, talking. One of them had a rifle. They went and went. Suddenly, a bear went out of the forest and ran to the mates. The mate who had a riffle, quickly climbed a tree. The other mate could not climb a tree, he fell down to the ground. The bear came to him, sniffed him and went back to the forest. The second mate went down from the tree and said to his mate: "What did the bear say to you?" Then another mate said: "The bear said that a real friend will not leave each other in trouble."
